owner_calls.question: The Savage Land's region says Antarctica, but its pin at [-56, -68.5] sits in the open sea of the Drake Passage, about 700 km north of the Antarctic Peninsula. Is that a deliberate stand-in (the Earth map may not show below about -60), or should the pin move onto Antarctica? (Raised in an earlier audit and still unchanged.)
options: Move the pin onto Antarctica, e.g. about [-64, -60] on the Antarctic Peninsula
owner_calls.evidence: X-Men '97 #17 (S2E7 'Strange Land, Savage Heart'): the Acolytes' Savage Land base is in Antarctica; the entry itself checks out (Marvel Database lists Exodus's death in the episode).
